tools.name: ForgePact
tools.summary: Offline gameplay modifiers: density, spawns, drop rates, map reveal.
tools.notes:
# ForgePact 1.4.4

The mod loader (`YYToolkit.dll`) that ForgePact installs is rebuilt from source
this project can fully account for, instead of a binary whose original source
was lost.

## Fixed

- **The mod loader is rebuilt from source this project can fully account
  for.** Every ForgePact release from 1.3.1 through 1.4.3 shipped
  a `YYToolkit.dll` built by a previous maintainer whose original source was
  never kept — the notice that shipped with it described two changes, but the
  binary itself contained more than that, and a fresh build of the two files
  that *were* kept crashed during startup and never got the game running.
  1.4.4 instead ships a `YYToolkit.dll` built from a documented set of changes
  to the published YYToolkit project that anyone can read and rebuild
  themselves; a `YYToolkit-BUILD-INFO.json` file installed beside the DLL
  records exactly what went into the copy you have.

  **Checked so far (2026-09-19, one machine, one game build):** with the new
  loader by itself, the game starts, and a roughly two-minute Chaos Tower
  session that raised 133 of the game's own caught errors ran with no lag
  seen, where the previous loader lagged heavily in the same content. With
  ForgePact 1.4.4's plugin and the HS Offline Tracker producer also loaded on
  the new loader, the game starts, the plugin loads and installs its hooks,
  and a handful of panel commands — a ping, and the globe/orb pickup option
  switched on, read back, and switched off again — answered normally.

  **Not yet checked:** playing with mods switched on for any real length of
  time on the new loader; whether the lag improvement holds once the plugin
  is loaded (the lag observation above was made with the loader alone); and
  other machines or game builds. This file will be corrected if any of that
  turns up a problem.

## How to update

Download and extract the complete release, then reopen ForgePact. Your existing
settings are retained. Source users can run `Prepare-Plugin.bat` if plugin files
are missing before using **Install Mod Plugin**. This change is in the mod
loader, so pressing **Install Mod Plugin** matters — updating only the panel
leaves the old `YYToolkit.dll` in place.

Use ForgePact only with an offline / EAC-disabled copy of Hero Siege.

tools.name: Hero Siege Item Editor
tools.summary: Item creator, stash editor and inventory customizer.
tools.notes:
# Hero Siege Item Editor 2.15.10

Pairs with [AFK FARM](https://github.com/falorfrozen-cmd/HS-AFK-Expedition) 0.6.4 and ForgePact 1.3.10 or newer.

## What's new

- **AFK FARM rewards land in the Infinite Vault.** Each AFK FARM expedition gets its own category, sorted into rarity stashes. Keys, materials, runes and gems go to **AFK Materials**. Keep the editor open while AFK FARM transfers; your game saves are not touched.
- **Materials stack.** Keys, materials, runes and gems of the same kind merge into stacks of up to 999, both when AFK FARM transfers them and when you press **COMPACT ITEMS**.
- **DISMANTLE for AFK loot.** You see what will happen before you confirm, and a backup of the Vault is kept.
  - Each stash of an AFK category has a **DISMANTLE** button.
  - The category menu has **DISMANTLE BY RARITY…** for the whole category.
  - Satanic and higher equipment is broken down the way the Prospector does it: Satanic Crystal Fragments, or a Dice, Gypsy's or Mallet Fragment for S and SS tier. The fragments go to AFK Materials.
  - Items below Satanic are deleted, because gold cannot be added outside the game.
- **Delete categories and stashes.** **DELETE CATEGORY** (category menu) and **DELETE STASH** (stash header) show what will be removed and keep a backup.
- **Clean up by rarity** deletes every item of the rarities you tick in one category. Items you gave a custom name are kept.
- **Large categories open quickly.** A category with thousands of items opens in a fraction of a second.
- **Miner's Helmet** is added to Item Forge's signature items. Its 4× mining ore and Vein Resonance need ForgePact 1.4.5 or newer.

## Before you update

The first time 2.15.10 opens your Infinite Vault, it upgrades the Vault to a new format after writing a backup. Older editors cannot open the upgraded Vault.

Everything else is as in 2.15.4. Download the exe and run it; no install.

tools.name: AFK FARM
tools.summary: Timed offline expeditions from your hero's measured farming pace.
tools.notes:
Timed offline expeditions for Hero Siege. Calibrate your hero's farming pace once, start an expedition and claim the rewards later. The game itself generates every kill's loot, XP and gold through its own drop calls. Windows only; the interface is in English.

## Download

**AFK-FARM-0.6.4.zip**: extract the whole folder and open **AFK FARM.exe**. Python is bundled, so nothing else needs installing. `START_HERE.md` in the package walks through the setup.

- **Requirements:** Hero Siege on Windows, with Aurie and YYToolkit installed for your game version. **Install AFK plugin** in the panel's Settings installs the plugin and backs up any previous one. The Settings page also shows whether your game build, Aurie, YYToolkit and the installed plugin are supported.
- **Where items go:** Items go to Hero Siege Item Editor's Infinite Vault, which needs Item Editor 2.15.5 or later (currently on its `master` branch). XP and gold are saved by the game.
- **Integrity:** SHA-256 of the zip is in `AFK-FARM-0.6.4.zip.sha256`; `MANIFEST.json` inside lists every file's hash.

## What's new in 0.6

- **0.6.0:** faster delivery (Normal, Fast and Maximum speeds), pause and continue, a Vault filter, and quality-of-life fixes.
- **0.6.1:**
  - A delivery can continue from its recorded position after a crash.
  - A Windows notification appears when an expedition is ready.
  - Adds a region comparison.
  - Vault categories are named after the hero and the time claimed.
- **0.6.2:** Items your loot filter hides are converted in the game during delivery.
  - Items below Satanic are sold for gold. Satanic and above are broken down with the Prospector's recipes.
  - This happens only while the game has no server connection.
- **0.6.3:** A loadout, level or combat setting that changed after calibrating no longer blocks a claim. The calibrated pace still sets the rewards.
- **0.6.4:** The panel's loadout notes and the Start question now describe that rule correctly.

## Notes

- **Beta.** Automatic game startup and **Claim in background** support the verified game executable only.
- **Play offline.** Use AFK FARM with your offline heroes only.
- **Item transfers.** Never replay rewards to repair an item transfer; use **Transfer to Vault** in Loot instead.

tools.name: HS Offline Tracker
tools.summary: Loot journal, drop alerts and an always-on-top run overlay.
tools.notes:
# HS Offline Tracker 0.1.3

A cleaner mod loader, and an existing install now keeps it up to date.

## What is new

**The bundled mod loader is replaced with a documented build.** The Tracker ships YYToolkit, the loader that lets the live sensor run inside the game. The copy it used to ship was an older, undocumented build, the same one ForgePact shipped, and nobody could say exactly what was in it. It is now a build made from a published, documented set of changes. A small record of exactly what it was built from now ships next to it.

**Updating the Tracker now updates the loader in your game folder too.** Before, the loader was installed once and never touched again: a newer Tracker brought a newer loader, but the old one stayed in your game folder, and "Reinstall live sensor" said it worked while changing nothing. Settings > Game link now tells you when the installed loader is an older build, and Reinstall live sensor replaces it. A loader it does not recognise, for example a newer one from another tool, is left alone and reported, never overwritten.

**Every build is checked before it ships.** The mod loader files in a release are now checked against a list of their expected fingerprints, so a wrong or incomplete file stops the release instead of reaching you as a sensor that silently refuses to start.

## Install

Run the setup, open Settings > Game link, press Install, then start Hero Siege. If the game folder has no mod loader, the Tracker installs one for you. If it has the older one, Settings says so, and Reinstall live sensor brings it up to date. The portable zip is the same program without an installer; keep the `producer` and `aurie-loader` folders next to the exe.

## Notes

If you also use ForgePact, use version 1.4.4 or newer: it ships the same loader. Both tools install the loader into the same place, so installing an older ForgePact after this puts the old loader back. Reinstall live sensor fixes that.

Magic find is still not shown: the game's stat routine cannot be observed on this build without destabilising it. The sensor only reads; it never writes to the game.

## Files

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `HS Offline Tracker_0.1.3_x64-setup.exe` | Installer, carries the sensor and the loader |
| `hs-offline-tracker-0.1.3-portable.zip` | Portable build, no installer |
| `SHA256SUMS-0.1.3.txt` | Checksums for the two files above |

HSCraftSim 1.0.4 is the Community edition, with Falor's creator credit and Discord link. The previous host credit and host Discord link have been removed from About and the footer.

Eligible Crystal-removal and Wisdom recipes now appear first under **Suggested next step**, including when materials still need to be added. This respects recipe filters and does not change the selected recipe, craft rules or Undo randomness.

A separate Website edition can be generated locally with **Created by Falor** and no Discord links. The files attached to this release are the Community edition.

### Download

- **HSCraftSim.exe**: standalone Windows application.
- **HSCraftSim-1.0.4-Windows-x64.zip**: the same EXE with instructions, notices and verification report.
- **HSCraftSim-1.0.4-Source.zip**: source code. Extracted game data is excluded; follow LOCAL-DATA.md before running or rebuilding from source.
- **HSCraftSim-1.0.4-SHA256SUMS.txt**: download checksums.

Windows 10/11 x64 and Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime are required. Existing desktop sessions are preserved.

### Validation

Passed the regression suite, static web package checks, About/footer navigation at five desktop and mobile sizes for both editions, Website Python/WebView2 startup, and two isolated launches of the standalone Community EXE with session restoration. Public source packaging passed the repository's distribution checks.

tools.notes:
# Hero Siege Save Editor v1.4.1

## What changed

- Fixed: the editor refused to open the Ether state with "Ether quest progress produced a fractional point total" when an Ether quest chain sat at an odd stage (for example a Wormhole chain at 7 after an Inferno challenge run). The game floors each chain's stage before awarding points, so a half-finished quest simply pays nothing yet; the editor now does the same instead of stopping.
- No other behaviour changed. Ether totals, presets and staged saves work as in 1.4.0.

## Tested

- All 90 automated tests pass, including a new one for odd quest stages.
- The point formula was checked against the game's own StatEtherPoints routine.

This tool is for offline/single-player characters only. Close Hero Siege before editing and keep the automatic backup.

tools.name: HS Steam Deck Save Editor
tools.summary: Browser-based save editor for Steam Deck and handheld players.
tools.notes:
## HSSaveEditor Steam Deck Web v1.0.0

First stable Steam Deck / offline web release of HSSaveEditor.

This version was built for Steam Deck users who cannot conveniently use the Windows desktop editor. It runs fully offline in the browser and can edit Hero Siege `.hss` character save files without installing anything.

### Download

- **HSSaveEditor-SteamDeck-Web-v1.0.0.zip**  
  Offline web editor for Steam Deck and Chromium-based browsers.

### Highlights

- Added Steam Deck friendly offline web editor.
- Added browser-based `.hss` character save editing.
- Added direct save support for compatible Chromium-based browsers.
- Edited files now keep the original filename instead of downloading as an edited copy.
- Hid Gold and Professions fields in the web build because those values are backed by `shop.ini`, which Steam Deck browser file pickers usually cannot access reliably.
- Added character editing tools such as waypoint unlock and Inferno unlock.
- Added raw decoded text view.
- Added read-only inventory inspector.

### How to use

1. Close Hero Siege.
2. Extract the zip file.
3. Open `index.html` in a Chromium-based browser.
4. Select your `.hss` character save file.
5. Edit the values you want.
6. Use `Save Directly...` if supported, or `Download Edited .hss` and replace the original file manually.

### Notes

- Intended for offline/single-player saves only.
- Do not use with online characters, multiplayer, leaderboards, trading, or anti-cheat protected modes.
- Keep a backup of your original save before editing.

tools.name: Hero Siege Codex
tools.summary: Explore items, classes, creatures, and the world.
tools.notes:
First public test edition of **Hero Siege Codex** for Hero Siege Toolkit.

Explore items, classes, creatures, and the world in the offline Scholar's Index interface. Includes 1,990 equipment entries, 167 relics, 89 stat descriptions, 24 classes, 325 creature entries, 217 Ether nodes and 200 quests.

- **Toolkit:** refresh the library, search for Hero Siege Codex and select Install. Toolkit manages the Portable ZIP and checks the signed catalog's SHA-256.
- **Standalone portable:** extract `HeroSiegeItemCodex-0.5.0-Windows-x64-Portable.zip` and run `hero-siege-item-codex.exe`.
- **Standalone setup:** run `HeroSiegeItemCodex-0.5.0-Setup.exe` to install for your Windows account and register entry links.
- Use **Ctrl+O** to open shared entry links in either edition.

Windows x64 with Microsoft Edge WebView2. No running game, administrator access or website account is required. The packaged archive works offline; external links require internet.

This is a **public test build**, not a claim of complete current-game coverage. See `TEST_RESULTS.md` in the ZIP for checks and remaining tester coverage. The EXE is unsigned. The existing desktop build is distributed unchanged; website snapshot `888939603820819ab321222f34fc27744c54e3d5`, desktop version `0.5.0`.

Report problems through this repository's Issues using the in-app **Report an issue** details. Checksums are supplied in `SHA256SUMS.txt`; dependency notices and provenance are inside the ZIP.
